title: Za'atar Spice Mix
steps: Dry-fry sesame seeds in a pan for ~2 minutes until lightly toasted and just starting to pop.
Pour into a jam jar; add remaining ingredients; shake to mix.
notes: Use in Za'atar & Orange Roast Chicken with Lemon Roast Potatoes (p.110). Can be bought ready-mixed if preferred.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
